title: BrightMode
description: Toggle maximum brightness with one keypress. See everything in caves, the deep dark, and the Nether without torches.
body:
## BrightMode

Tired of placing torches just to see? BrightMode cranks brightness to max instantly.

### What it does
- **Toggle fullbright** -- one keypress, max gamma
- **Smooth fade** -- optional gradual transition
- **Night vision mode** -- vanilla-friendly alternative

### How to use
- Default: **B** (rebindable)
- Config via Mod Menu -> BrightMode

### Compatibility
Client-side only, pure visual change.

## Changelog
### v1.0.0
- Initial release: one-key brightness/fullbright toggle with optional smooth fade.
